html: The Goreng, also written Koreng, are a Noongar people of the south coast of Western Australia, in the country between Albany and the Fitzgerald River. The map shows them from 1600 to 1815. Little is recorded about them as a separate group. Their neighbours were the Minang to the west, the Wudjari to the east and the Wiilman, Kaniyang and Nyaki-nyaki inland. Farms spread east from Albany over their land in the later 1800s.
